_name: Error — a fetch rejects past the .catch([]) guard
_note: Per-client .catch(()=>[]) swallows individual failures; this case rejects the outer Promise.all chain (e.g. a throw before .then) so loading:false + error set → <div class="kpage-error">. NOTE: .kpage-error has no real style in contracts.css/dashboard.css — renders as unstyled text (flagged hazard).
